rationale: The short reached a maximum favorable excursion of 2.28% (touching ~$844 low) but has since bounced sharply, with the last two candles showing strong recovery from $844 to $870, putting price back near entry. The position is still below the invalidation at $899.50 and the take-profit at $848 remains viable if selling resumes, but the bounce is notable and momentum has shifted short-term bullish. Holding with existing stops in place is appropriate given the automated invalidation level provides defined risk, and the broader gap-fade thesis hasn't been structurally invalidated yet.
